create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with a sampling distribution
build_ordered_indices: build ordered indices for multi-corpus dataset sampling using a specified random seed and distribution
test_map_index: test the _map_index method to resolve a global index to a dataset-specific index and key
review_collater: review the collater method that delegates batch collation to the first underlying dataset
summarize_sample: summarize the _sample method that picks a dataset by distribution and returns a sampled index
